verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client with cloud-synced team vaults, so outbound event webhooks are a plausible capability for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence documents registrable HTTP callbacks or any event subscription mechanism, and the OpenAPI probe found no public API spec. Session logs, Cloud Sync and real-time vault updates are adjacent features, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
